website.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
website.privacy.intro: {company} respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
website.privacy.s1.title: Who we are
website.privacy.s1.body: {company} is a platform specialising in sleep apnoea that connects patients with certified dentists. We are the data controller for your personal data under GDPR.
website.privacy.s2.title: Data we collect
website.privacy.s2.body: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide: first and last name, phone number, email address, city, and information about your symptoms or treatment needs. For dental professionals, we also collect clinic details and tax identification number.
website.privacy.s3.title: How we use your data
website.privacy.s3.body: We use your data to match you with a certified dentist in your area, manage your enquiry, and communicate with you. The applicable legal basis depends on your jurisdiction: pre-contractual measures (GDPR Art. 6.1.b — EU; LFPDPPP Art. 9 — Mexico; PDPA — Thailand). For health data, we always rely on your explicit consent.
website.privacy.s4.title: Data sharing
website.privacy.s4.body: We share your data only with the certified dentist managing your case and with technical service providers under confidentiality agreements. We never sell or transfer your data for commercial purposes.
website.privacy.s5.title: Retention
website.privacy.s5.body: We retain your data for as long as necessary for the stated purpose, and at most 3 years from last contact. Data related to active treatment is retained for the duration of the relationship.
website.privacy.s6.title: Your rights
website.privacy.s6.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data (GDPR — EU). In Mexico, you may also exercise ARCO rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, Opposition) under the LFPDPPP. In Thailand, equivalent rights apply under the PDPA. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}. You may also contact the relevant authority in your country: AEPD (Spain/EU), INAI (Mexico), or PDPC (Thailand).
website.privacy.s7.title: Cookies
website.privacy.s7.body: We only use essential technical cookies required for the site to function. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.
website.privacy.s8.title: Changes & contact
website.privacy.s8.body: We may update this policy occasionally. Significant changes will be communicated by email or via a notice on the website. For any privacy-related enquiries, contact us at {email}.
website.about.heroSub: NeoSleep bridges the science of dental sleep medicine with the patients who need it most — evidence-based, human-centered, built for lasting results.
website.about.mission.body: Millions suffer silently from sleep apnea — a condition that quietly undermines heart health, cognitive performance, and quality of life. We built NeoSleep to change that. Our platform connects certified dental professionals with patients through evidence-based, non-invasive oral appliance therapy. Every protocol, every feature, every interaction is grounded in peer-reviewed research and shaped by the lived experiences of our patients and clinicians.
website.about.values.heading: What we stand for
website.about.values.research.title: Research-Driven
website.about.values.research.desc: Every recommendation is backed by clinical evidence. We don't assume — we measure, validate, and continuously refine our protocols against the latest science.
website.about.values.human.title: Human-Centered
website.about.values.human.desc: We design for real people: patients who are exhausted, dentists with full schedules. Empathy drives our product decisions as much as data does.
website.about.values.innovation.title: Innovation-First
website.about.values.innovation.desc: From AI-assisted diagnostics to seamless digital care workflows, we push the boundaries of what dental sleep medicine can be — without sacrificing simplicity.
website.about.values.eco.title: Eco-Conscious
website.about.values.eco.desc: Our devices are built for longevity, not disposability. We minimise waste across our supply chain and partner with suppliers who share our responsibility to the planet.
website.about.approach.heading: From insight to impact
website.about.approach.sub: A clear path from first assessment to lasting results.
website.about.approach.step1.title: Diagnose
website.about.approach.step1.desc: Advanced sleep assessments pinpoint the severity and pattern of each patient's condition, enabling truly personalised care.
website.about.approach.step2.title: Match
website.about.approach.step2.desc: Patients are connected with a certified dentist who specialises in sleep apnea treatment — in their area, on their schedule.
website.about.approach.step3.title: Monitor
website.about.approach.step3.desc: Outcomes are tracked and protocols adjusted continuously — because great care doesn't stop at the first fitting.
website.about.cta.heading: Ready to be part of the change?
website.about.cta.sub: Whether you're a patient seeking relief or a dentist ready to expand your practice — NeoSleep is built for you.
